name: ClickUp
author: Aislan Dener Souza Vicentini
description: Your assigned ClickUp tasks in the bar, grouped by workflow status, with one keystroke to move a task forward.

barWidget.description: Open tasks assigned to you across the whole workspace, grouped by the status they sit in, with due dates, sprint tags and an inline status picker.

schema.label: Section order
schema.description: Comma-separated status names, first to last. Leave empty to follow the order the statuses have in ClickUp itself.

schema.label: Rows shown per section
schema.description: Collapsed size of each section. Every section can still be expanded to its full contents.
